name: Åsa - Frillesås
description: Åsa to Frillesås. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: Official geometry is internally consistent but multipart with a 112.88 m break on Åsa Kustpromenad.
K4 ends in Frillesås while the next listed coastal section currently starts at Steninge, about 67.2 km straight-line away.
K4 has a usable official GPX/API geo_json, but API line.geometry is absent/null.
Route-app notes conflict between dog-friendly/on-leash and no-dog beach commentary.
Visit Kungsbacka describes large parking, while Naturkartan snippets may describe limited parking.
Rågelund has official toilet/camping context but no official Hallandsleden public drinking-water tag.
